items.title: Key takeaways from the Islamabad peace talks between US and Iran
items.description: After an absolute marathon of overnight negotiations and historic high-level talks between the United States and Iran, a deal to end the war that has thrown the Middle East and global energy supplies into chaos has not been reached.

items.title: Trump says US Navy will begin Strait of Hormuz blockade after failed talks
items.description: US President Donald Trump made the comments after the US and Iran failed to reach an agreement after 21 hours in talks in Islamabad.

items.title: Trump is the latest to enter a decades-long fight for this nation's gold
items.description: The stockpile is part of a longer skirmish for access to and control of a bonanza playing out an ocean away, in a country clambering to reinvent itself amid political turmoil.

items.title: Police charge gang rapist who escaped from Sydney hospital five days ago
items.description: On Wednesday, Michael Angok fled on foot from Bankstown Hospital shortly after 9:30am. He had been taken there from Villawood Detention Centre.

items.title: Emergency warning issued after blaze at Perth battery recycling facility
items.description: A man has been taken to hospital and a HAZMAT emergency warning has been issued as a serious fire burns at a lithium-ion battery recycling facility in Perth.

items.title: This viral craze is leaving a trail of battered bodies. Exponents want sporting legitimacy
items.description: Vali stands atop a cliff. He screams, psyching himself up. Three, two, one jump — then in mere seconds he smacks the water 42 metres below, sustaining massive injuries.

items.title: Live: Day kicks off Masters final round, chasing McIlroy
items.description: Australia's Jason Day is among the primary challengers as Rory McIlroy tries to hold on for a second straight Masters victory at Augusta National. Follow live.

items.title: Gout Gout smashes his Australian 200m record and goes under 20 seconds at Nationals
items.description: Gout Gout has produced a breathtaking run to break 20 seconds in the 200 metres for the first time, and smash his own national record.

items.title: Hull closes national titles on her terms with 5k win after shock 1,500m fall
items.description: Olympic silver medallist Jess Hull was reeling after her fall in the 1,500m at the Australian Athletics Championships, but has regrouped to win the 5,000m.

items.title: Eels booed by their fans after 42-point loss, Tigers carve up Knights
items.description: Parramatta coach Jason Ryles says Eels fans had a right to boo their team after watching the Gold Coast Titans score nine tries in a 52-10 belting at Western Sydney Stadium.

items.title: The animation on this show was generated by AI. Would you watch it?
items.description: A television show that uses generative artificial intelligence to animate Indonesian folktales is creating a stir.

items.title: Legendary Bollywood singer Asha Bhosle dies aged 92
items.description: The singer recorded over 12,000 songs and was one of Indian cinema's most celebrated voices.

items.title: No work, no savings, no way to wait: India's migrant workers head home
items.description: The war in the Middle East has brought one of India's largest industrial hubs to a standstill. In the city of Morbi, hundreds of thousands of workers have lost their jobs, after gas supplies were disrupted thousands of kilometres away.

items.title: Queen Mary of Denmark's father dies in Tasmania aged 84
items.description: The Australian-born Queen of Denmark last visited her father Professor John Donaldson during a royal visit to Tasmania last month.

items.title: Hiker found 'safe and well' after spending 24 hours lost in Victoria's north-west
items.description: Police have located a hiker who separated from his group and was missing for more than 24 hours in Victoria's north-west.

items.title: 'It's not my kidney now, it's yours. I'm just holding it for you'
items.description: Despite a 10-year age gap and geographical separation, Sajarn and Codey Stow have retained a close bond since childhood. That bond has only strengthened since Codey received a donor kidney from his brother last November.

items.title: I thought I understood China. Then I ordered a craft beer
items.description: On a midsummer night last year, I took a sip of lager at a craft beer pub in my hometown in China's south. But this was not just a beer. It was a cultural symbol that shows just how much China's Gen Z is changing.

items.title: Woman, 25, drowns at popular swimming hole near Alice Springs
items.description: The woman died despite resuscitation efforts from paramedics, Northern Territory Police say.

items.title: New Zealand braces for worst impacts as Cyclone Vaianu makes landfall
items.description: Floods and power outages are reported in New Zealand, as authorities warn the worst damage from Cyclone Vaianu is yet to come.

items.title: A labour hire firm's demise leaves workers out of pocket
items.description: Prominent labour hire company iComply owed more than $12 million when it collapsed, according to a damning liquidator's report, with workers chasing millions in superannuation.

items.title: Why diesel price continues to soar in spite of fuel excise cut
items.description: As the war in the Middle East rages on, diesel prices are continuing to rise despite efforts to stabilise costs. So why is this happening, can anything be done about it and is the worst yet to come?

items.title: 'It's taken me all over the world': Life as a second-generation human cannonball
items.description: David Smith grew up watching his father being shot out of a cannon, so when the time came, he said it was inevitable he would follow in his dad's flight path.

items.title: 'This was not easy': Artemis II crew's first comments
items.description: Artemis crew members have described their mission as "the greatest dream on Earth" after landing on Saturday and setting a new deep-space travel record.

items.title: Minister casts doubt on road user tax due to EV uptake concerns
items.description: A new tax on road users, including electric vehicles, has been cast into doubt by the transport minister, who says now may not be the time for it.

items.title: At least 30 dead in Haiti stampede, death toll could rise
items.description: At least 30 people were killed on Saturday in a stampede in the northern countryside of Haiti, authorities said, warning that the death toll could rise.
